notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Greetings!

Feeting patch to address some issues and add some new content.

Here is list of changes:

 Added content to reward players for reaching ranks after S rank.
 Rebalanced the game to make progression more smooth.
 Minor fixes and tweaks.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
